name: smwmusic-illusion-of-gaia-drifting-endlessly
title: Illusion of Gaia - Drifting Endlessly
description:
A nice little lullaby. Or the last song you hear before passing out while you are adrift, vibing with your girlfriend and eating fresh fish and drinking salty water for 40 days.

This song ranked 27/46 in Super Famicompo 2. After voters' comments, I have upgraded it appropriately.
